items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I was working with Dave Payton band out to the Persian Palace.

ctx.x: How did you do that? I'm telling you you're jumping all over.

Well, I can't remember all of them. You just ask me the question. I'll tell you. I'll ask you the questions. I was working with Dave Payton band out to the Persian Palace. That's a Persian hotel at 64th and Cottage. Al Turner had the place. Used to have the Grand Auto Inn where later it was the plantation in Chicago. And I got a nice offer to go down and play with them and I left this band and went, left Dave Payton and went to the plantation with Joe. And I left the band. Who was? That was in 1924. That's after…
